name: spacefast-sec
description: SecMon x Spacefast 6-Phase Security & CVE Auditor. Scans Spacefast (*.space.fast / drop.fast) projects for CVEs (OSV + cve.now + CISA KEV + EPSS), leaked secrets, VITE_/NEXT_PUBLIC_ bundle leaks, fail-open defaults, live HTTP exposure, and local-vs-Space drift.
skillInstructions: Use spacefast MCP to read Space files and spacefast-sec MCP to audit dependencies, code, secrets, and live exposure. Never report a Space as safe unless overallState is 'clean' and validationReasons is empty. Always ask for explicit user approval before writing remediation diffs back to the Space.
